landmarks.anatomy: Superficial registration of addressed radiocarpal interval

modelIndicator.construction: APB superficial facet488 supports transfer of styloid/scaphoid/APL structural relation to the current palmar envelope. APB itself is not the location definition.
limitations: No observed skin crease, radial artery or pulsation; approximate structural model indicator.

landmarks.anatomy: Lateral cubital interval adjacent to distal biceps tendon

modelIndicator.construction: Observed distal tendon facet351 near distal humeral articulation. Authored cubital indicator at joint plane and 4mm lateral correspondence; no source skin crease or 90-degree flexion produced.
limitations: Elbow is extended; flexible crease/depression transferred as static structural indicator only.
